meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.

You asked for this meeting, Hale, so you'll make the time. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you contact me before any mark is entered, and I'm writing down that the zero stands with no basis given. Tell me what it rests on, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
Show me both. Which line, exactly, and where is it in the essay? I want the outline with the October 15 date on it, in front of me, not described.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and copies of the quoted line and the October 15 outline you described. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: the misquoted Hamlet line and the dated October 15 outline got her asking to see the documents, but she never saw them, so her position didn't shift.
